headline: Saudi firm agrees to explore $30 billion energy infrastructure projects in Pakistan
summary: A Saudi Arabian company signed an agreement to explore energy infrastructure developments in Pakistan with a proposed investment value of $30 billion.
why: Pakistan faces recurrent energy bottlenecks; foreign direct investment commitments from Gulf partners are critical for upgrading its power and grid infrastructure.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: The preliminary $30 billion energy infrastructure pact could substantially increase foreign investment.
